text:
incident-bot: P1 alert — Orion Systems (enterprise) reporting elevated 5xx rates and slow embeddings responses in Dedicated EU cluster eu-west-3. Error spike started ~7001234400, routing failures to backend pool-3. Paging on-call (alex.oncall).

alex.oncall: Ack. I'm pulling logs now — switching pagerduty to me. ETA 5m.

jamal.sre: I'm seeing a sharp increase in 503s from transformer-host-12 and increased tail latency on long-seq requests. Logs show repeated upstream: connection reset by peer.

alex.oncall: Any recent deploys in that cluster? /releases

jamal.sre: Yes, small infra rollout 7001234300 — nginx proxy hotfix. Rolling window aligns. Suspect proxy config or new keepalive defaults.

priya.account: Orion's engineering lead is online. Need a short customer-facing impact statement ASAP — they want to know which features affected and recommended mitigation.

lina.support: Draft status update for status.redwood.com and an email to Orion below.

lina.support: STATUS PAGE SNIPPET:
```
Status: Degraded performance and increased errors for embeddings on Dedicated EU cluster (eu-west-3).
Impact: A subset of Orion Systems requests may fail with 5xx errors or experience elevated latency.
Workaround: We are routing traffic to standby nodes; some calls may succeed with retries. No data loss reported.
ETA: Next update in 30 minutes.
```

lina.support: CUSTOMER EMAIL DRAFT:
```
Hi <Orion team>,

We're currently investigating elevated error rates and latency impacting embeddings on your Dedicated EU cluster. Our on-call and SRE teams are actively mitigating; we have initiated traffic reroutes and a rollback of a recent proxy change. We'll follow up with status updates every 30 minutes or as the situation changes. No data loss expected. For urgent issues, please reply-all to this thread or call the on-call number.

Regards,
Priya (Account Lead) and Redwood Ops
```

priya.account: That looks good. Please add explicit list of affected endpoints for their ops team.

jamal.sre: Affected endpoints (samples):
- POST /v1/embeddings
- POST /v1/complete (long-seq)
- Internal cache refresh job hitting model-hosts

jamal.sre: I'm going to start a rollback of the proxy change on proxy-pool-eu-west-3 now.

alex.oncall: Command I ran:
```
/redploy --service proxy --cluster eu-west-3 --rollback 7001234300
```

sre-manager-bob: If rollback doesn't restore, prepare fallback plan to shift Orion traffic to dedicated standby region (eu-central-1). Priya, please confirm standby routing authorization in the account contract.

priya.account: Confirmed standby routing allowed per contract clause 4.2. I'll notify Orion that we may shift traffic and request approval to proceed if needed.

maria.product: Quick note — if we shift region we may see ~100-180ms RTT increase for some endpoints. Call that out to Orion.

alex.oncall: Rollback in progress. Initial metrics show 30% drop in 5xx after stop. Keeping watch. Will post graphs in 10m.

lina.support: Adding Orion contact routing here for comms (from account spreadsheet):
- alex.harper@orion.com (Eng lead)
- mona.singh@orion.com (Prod Ops)
- ops-oncall@orion.com (24/7)
Notify sequence: email -> call ops-oncall -> escalate to Eng lead if no ack in 15m.

priya.account: I'll start the outreach now and paste their internal thread link when available.

jamal.sre: Monitoring — tail latency trending down but some pods still showing errors. Running `kubectl restart pod transformer-host-12` on the worst nodes.

alex.oncall: Patch applied and restart completed. Post-rollback metrics look stable so far. Preparing status update for 7001234700.

lina.support: I'll publish the status page update and send the customer email now. Priya — please review before send.

priya.account: Reviewed, send it. Keep me in thread.

incident-bot: Incident status changed: acknowledged -> mitigating. Incident channel pinned.

alex.oncall: Mitigation in progress, traffic reroutes and rollback applied. Will continue to monitor for 60m before closing or escalating. If we see >5% error rate persist, we failover region.

sre-manager-bob: Thanks team. Retrospective: capture deploy gating gap and add a proxy canary check to rollout board. I'll own the action after incident.

priya.account: Orion notified and acknowledged. They asked for a short postmortem and timeline once incident is closed.

alex.oncall: Noted. I'll collect timestamps and commands and handoff to postmortem doc owner. Closing loop once stable.

lina.support: Updating internal comms template so we capture affected endpoints and exact user-impact copy for enterprise customers.

alex.oncall: Final note — we'll post a 1-hour follow-up with root cause and next steps. :thumbsup:
